title: Total Hamming Distance

monster.name: Cross-Bit Colossus
monster.title: Accumulator of Bit Differentials
monster.defeatQuote: Sum of Hamming distances between all pairs of integers evaluated in O(32 * n)!

description: The Hamming distance between two integers is the number of positions at which the corresponding bits are different. Given an integer array `nums`, return the sum of Hamming distances between all the pairs of the integers in `nums`.
solutionCode:
def totalHammingDistance(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    total = 0
    n = len(nums)
    for bit in range(32):
        ones = sum((x >> bit) & 1 for x in nums)
        total += ones * (n - ones)
    return total
hints: Inspect each bit position independently: if `ones` numbers have a 1 and `n - ones` have a 0, they contribute ones * (n - ones).

python.solutionCode:
def totalHammingDistance(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    total = 0
    n = len(nums)
    for bit in range(32):
        ones = sum((x >> bit) & 1 for x in nums)
        total += ones * (n - ones)
    return total
